support_hub_desc: Select your preferred channel to contact our support team. We will respond to your inquiry as soon as possible.
support_channel_email_desc: Submit a formal, detailed request. We will reply directly to your email address.
support_channel_chat_desc: Instant messaging support with an active customer agent.
support_logged_in_as: Logged in as @{username} ({email}). Your request will be automatically attached to your account.
support_category_desc: Select the area that corresponds to your request.
support_subject_desc: Provide a brief and descriptive title for your inquiry.
support_message_desc: Provide all relevant details to help us address your case.
placeholder_support_subject: e.g. Issue saving changes on canvas
placeholder_support_message: Describe your issue or question in detail so we can best assist you...
support_guest_desc: To contact our support team and receive personalized assistance linked to your account, please log in.
support_livechat_unavailable_desc: Our real-time chat service is temporarily offline. Please use the contact form to submit your inquiry.
msg_support_ticket_created: Your support ticket has been submitted successfully! Reference UUID: {uuid}
err_support_login_required: You must log in to contact support.
err_support_invalid_subject: Subject must be between 4 and 200 characters.
err_support_invalid_message: Message must be between 15 and 5000 characters.
err_support_submission_failed: An error occurred while submitting your ticket. Please try again.
